cc:Work.dc:title: Box - DisplayCase
cc:Work.dc:description:
Fully closed box intended to be cut from transparent acrylics and to serve as a display case.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DisplayCase --x 150 --y 80 --h 120 --outside 0 --overhang 5 --thickness 4 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes DisplayCase --x --y --h --outside --overhang --thickness --reference
